verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The primary canary operational contract is especially complete: approved production entry, 5% exposure, consecutive-window evaluation of all four metrics, ordered 25/50/100 ramp, telemetry pause, threshold freeze, and rollback to the last known-good image are all represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: R31 omits the migration controller as the actor responsible for conditional compensation, although the safe-only decision and compensating action are shown.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board represents nearly the entire brief across protected build and supply-chain gates, staging promotion and failure preservation, production canary progression, automatic rollback, control-plane consistency, auditing, notifications, and telemetry-loss operator handling. The sole partial requirement is the missing migration-controller responsibility on the otherwise complete safe-compensation path.
